_meta.description: 35 criteria (9 sectors x Technology/Regulation/Demand & Economics), the fixed assessment framework for the transition-feasibility assessment. Derived from docs/Transition_Barrier_Assessment.xlsx (Criteria Reference sheet), verified 2026-08-14. This is the join table -- primary_sources[] entries carry url/locator/access_pattern/refresh_cadence where verified. This file is authoritative; data/source_registry.json is a derived flattened view.
